title: FedCMAPSS: A Benchmark for Federated Learning in Remaining Useful Life Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.26433v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data-driven prognostics and health management has emerged as a key enabler for Industry 4.0, yet the development of robust remaining useful life (RUL) estimation models is often limited by the scarcity of run-to-failure data. While federated learning offers a promising paradigm to collaboratively train predictive models without sharing sensor data, research efforts have operated so far in the absence of a common evaluation framework. To address this gap, this paper introduces FedCMAPSS, a benchmark for federated RUL estimation based on the commonly-used NASA C-MAPSS dataset. We define a set of five standardized tasks designed to simulate real-world industrial challenges, ranging from ideal IID settings to extreme statistical heterogeneity, and conduct a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art federated optimization algorithms across multiple neural architectures. translated_title: FedCMAPSS：面向剩余使用寿命估计的联邦学习基准
translated_abstract: 数据驱动的预测与健康管理已成为工业4.0的关键推动因素，然而，鲁棒的剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计模型的开发往往受限于失效运行数据的稀缺性。尽管联邦学习提供了一种有前景的范式，可以在不共享传感器数据的情况下协作训练预测模型，但迄今为止的研究工作缺乏统一的评估框架。为解决这一空白，本文介绍了FedCMAPSS，一个基于广泛使用的NASA C-MAPSS数据集的联邦RUL估计基准。我们定义了一组五个标准化任务，旨在模拟真实世界的工业挑战，范围从理想的独立同分布（IID）设置到极端统计异质性，并对多种神经架构上的最先进联邦优化算法进行了系统评估。通过建立可复现的基线和公开源代码与数据，我们为联邦RUL估计研究提供了标准化平台。
tldr: 本文提出了FedCMAPSS，这是首个基于NASA C-MAPSS数据集的联邦剩余使用寿命估计基准，通过五个标准化任务和系统评估，为联邦学习在工业预测维护领域提供了统一的评估框架和可复现基线。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FedCMAPSS, the first benchmark for federated remaining useful life estimation based on the NASA C-MAPSS dataset, providing a unified evaluation framework and reproducible baselines through five standardized tasks and systematic assessment.
